description: Searches keys with the specified criteria and pagination.

algorithm.description: The algorithm of the key to search for.

name.description: The name of the key to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

orderBy.description: The field to order the results by. Supported values: algorithm, expiration, id, insertInstant, name, type.

startRow.description: The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

type.description: The type of key to search for. Supported values: EC, HMAC, OKP, RSA.

name: searchKeysByParametersWithId
